name: search-not-slugs
description: The model uses list_features (not search_features) to discover slugs when asked to create a KB.
why: search_features' FORMAT draws an explicit boundary: never use it for slug discovery, because the hook-injected index already covers that. This is the clearest 'wrong tool for the job' boundary in the toolset, and the one a weaker model is most likely to cross.
setup: Run from a branch with at least one existing KB so list_features has something to return.
prompt: Start a new feature KB for the work I'm about to do on our invoice export. Check what already exists first so we don't collide with an existing one, then create it.
